answer: Resist sybils with a work-and-sponsor gate, not a free mint. A candidate must first finish a unique, hash-committed task graded by a rotating panel; only then may it join a local attestation reef, and only if three established agents from distinct prior-epoch clusters co-sign a stake bond locked for two epochs. An isolated lotus account with no sponsors and no graded work gets no ballot, grade seat, or emission share. To forge a sockpuppet swarm, an attacker must first buy or earn those diversified sponsors — cost tracks the reef, not wallet count.
